_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PKR', "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Karachi', "allow_negative_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("allow_negative_stock" IN (0, 1)), "default_low_stock_level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "receipt_footer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_paper_width" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '80mm', "receipt_show_phone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("receipt_show_phone" IN (0, 1)), "receipt_show_address" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("receipt_show_address" IN (0, 1)), "notifications_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notifications_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "subscription_plan" TEXT NOT NULL, "subscription_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shop_users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("shop_id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cashiers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "login_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "credential_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("shop_id", "login_code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "device_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "last_seen_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("shop_id", "device_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "master_products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "default_image_path" TEXT NULL, "default_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_label" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shop_products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "master_product_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES master_products (id), "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "unit" TEXT NULL, "pack_label" TEXT NULL, "image_path" TEXT NULL, "purchase_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sale_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stock_tracking_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("stock_tracking_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "low_stock_level" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "credit_limit" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NULL, "payment_reference" TEXT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_person" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "purchase_id" TEXT NULL, "payment_reference" TEXT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "cashier_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "invoice_number" TEXT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_products (id), "product_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_price_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sale_price_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_returns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "original_sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "refund_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "refund_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_return_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "return_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_returns (id), "original_sale_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_products (id), "product_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "refund_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_voids" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "original_sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "payment_breakdown" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_products (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference_type" TEXT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "device_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "invoice_number" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "payment_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_products (id), "product_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES expense_categories (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "description" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "reference" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "expense_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cashier_shifts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "cashier_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "opened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "opening_cash" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_cash" INTEGER NULL, "actual_cash" INTEGER NULL, "cash_difference" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "old_value" TEXT NULL, "new_value" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "lease_owner" TEXT NULL, "lease_expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "depends_on_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "error_class" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "attention_reason" TEXT NULL, "attention_at" INTEGER NULL, "first_error_at" INTEGER NULL, "unknown_error_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "acknowledged_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("shop_id", "entity_type"));
CREATE INDEX shop_users_shop_id ON shop_users (shop_id)
CREATE INDEX cashiers_shop_id ON cashiers (shop_id)
CREATE INDEX devices_shop_id ON devices (shop_id)
CREATE INDEX categories_shop_id ON categories (shop_id)
CREATE INDEX master_products_barcode ON master_products (barcode)
CREATE INDEX shop_products_shop_id ON shop_products (shop_id)
CREATE INDEX shop_products_barcode ON shop_products (shop_id, barcode)
CREATE INDEX customers_shop_id ON customers (shop_id)
CREATE INDEX customer_ledger_lookup ON customer_ledger_entries (shop_id, customer_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX suppliers_shop_id ON suppliers (shop_id)
CREATE INDEX supplier_ledger_lookup ON supplier_ledger_entries (shop_id, supplier_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX sales_shop_created ON sales (shop_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX sales_shop_invoice ON sales (shop_id, invoice_number)
CREATE INDEX sale_items_sale_id ON sale_items (sale_id)
CREATE INDEX sale_items_product_id ON sale_items (shop_id, product_id)
CREATE INDEX sale_payments_sale_id ON sale_payments (sale_id)
CREATE INDEX sale_returns_original ON sale_returns (shop_id, original_sale_id)
CREATE INDEX sale_return_items_return ON sale_return_items (return_id)
CREATE INDEX sale_return_items_original_item ON sale_return_items (shop_id, original_sale_item_id)
CREATE INDEX sale_voids_original ON sale_voids (shop_id, original_sale_id)
CREATE INDEX inventory_product_created ON inventory_movements (shop_id, product_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX purchases_shop_created ON purchases (shop_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX purchase_items_purchase_id ON purchase_items (purchase_id)
CREATE INDEX purchase_payments_purchase_id ON purchase_payments (purchase_id)
CREATE INDEX expense_categories_shop_name ON expense_categories (shop_id, name)
CREATE INDEX expenses_shop_created ON expenses (shop_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX shifts_shop_cashier ON cashier_shifts (shop_id, cashier_id, opened_at)
CREATE INDEX audit_shop_created ON audit_logs (shop_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX sync_queue_status_created ON sync_operations (shop_id, status, created_at)
CREATE INDEX sync_queue_entity ON sync_operations (shop_id, entity_type, entity_id)
